$comment: DOSSIER-FORMAT §16.6 (DF-97): the LOCATIONS page's image copies, in one place, as template/page-copies.json is for the dossier page (DF-43). A plate is scaled to cover 1280×720 and cropped at the centre. A view is scaled, up or down, to the largest size that fits inside 1280×720, keeping its shape.
